subject: PICTURE clause
notes: kb/Work PB646 LANDED the leg this row was held open on, 2026-09-13. GR8 - 'To define an item as boolean, character-string-1 shall contain only one or more occurrences of the symbol 1' - defines the category without saying anything about usage, and one of its legal forms did not compile: `01 NB1 PIC 1(4) USAGE NATIONAL.` was COBOL0899 'national-form boolean data (PIC 1 with USAGE NATIONAL) is recognized but not yet implemented (Phase 4a residue)'. 13.18.60.3 SR12 admits a boolean picture under usage national by name, so that was a refusal of legal source; the arm is gone. MEASURED at --std 2023: `01 NBOOL PIC 1(4) USAGE NATIONAL VALUE B"1010".` binds and DISPLAYs [1010], FUNCTION LENGTH answers 4 (15.50.4 r1's boolean positions) and FUNCTION BYTE-LENGTH answers 8 (four NATIONAL character positions at 13.18.60.4 GR8's pinned two bytes). The display-form and bit-form legs are unchanged and still verified, and the 2002 introduction gate still rejects all three forms at 85.
